apps.name: AorusGram
apps.subtitle: Telegram with extra features
apps.localizedDescription:
AorusGram is a Telegram fork with features the original doesn't have. Everything runs on top of regular Telegram: the same chats, the same accounts, the same sync — there is just more you can do.

Privacy
• Ghost Mode — stay invisible: nobody sees you online, typing or reading. Can be turned on per chat.
• Watch stories without leaving a trace.
• Protection against spoofed deleted messages and against spam.
• Calls routed through a proxy, so your IP stays yours.

Wall
• An endless feed of unread posts from your channels — all in one place.
• Similar channels are mixed in automatically when your own posts run low.
• Swipe a channel away to drop it; read posts clear out when you refresh.

Messages
• Deleted and edited messages are kept — you see what was removed and how it was changed.
• Forward, save and download from chats where copying is blocked: photos, video, files, albums.
• Save view-once photos and videos.
• Download stories.
• Edit someone else's message locally — the change stays on your device.
• No limit on pinned chats.

Voice and video
• Change your voice in voice messages, round videos and calls.
• Face masks in round videos and video calls.
• Call recording, group calls included.
• Voice to text — quick transcription of voice messages.

Interface
• AMOLED theme, purple accent, your own fonts.
• Animated profile banner and live wallpapers.
• Text formatting panel.
• Change the app icon, square avatars, hide the tabs you never use.

More
• Built-in message translator.
• Faster downloads and maximum media quality.
• Automatic cache and memory cleanup, ad blocking.
• Sign in from a backup, and room for more accounts.

Updates arrive through the source — no reinstalling by hand.
apps.versionDescription:
The Wall — a new tab with an endless feed of posts from your channels and ones like them.

• Wall: unread posts in one feed, without switching between channels. Telegram's recommendations are mixed in when your own posts run low, and a channel you do not want goes away with a swipe.
• Pick a mask from inside a call or a round video — a button next to the camera, with the masks laid out on screen.
• A new Titanium badge, and a redrawn AorusGram one.
• The app now speaks 34 languages — every one Telegram offers.
• A quote spanning several lines is one quote again, instead of one per line.
• The proxy no longer drops when a VPN comes up or the network changes.
• Cache auto-clean now also reclaims the media the Wall downloaded.
• Less work for the CPU while scrolling the Wall.
